notes.title: New Game Mode! ⛳

⛳ [b]GOLF MODE[/b] ⛳
In a battle of precision and skill, compete head-to head to putt your ball in the fewest shots. Utilise the new aerial camera to survey your surroundings and make every shot count. Plus, hit your ball further than before with the new power dash mechanic! 🦾

We've added a handy tutorial to help you get a feel for it before taking on an opponent in casual or custom games.

We listened to the issues Grapple Hook has caused, requiring little skill but providing huge benefits. The ball is no longer frozen in place when Grapple Hook is active. This change has reduced the predictability of grapple, increasing the skill level required for useful shots.

notes.title: Custom Games Are Here!
notes.notes:
Hey Racers,

After much anticipation, Custom Games have arrived! So get your engines revving, tyres pumping and games updating... This is what's in store:

🔧 [b]Custom Games[/b] 🔧
Host games up to 8 players, in private or public custom games! Choose up to 12 levels, with specific pick ups, cores and bot settings! Did I mention you can choose to spectate too? 👀

🏆 [b]Ranked Improvements[/b] 🏆
No more losing points for winning! We've reverted back to New Skill, allowing you to rise the ranks faster! Ranked players will face off in 5 levels instead of 3, and to prevent foul play, homing missiles will no longer appear in ranked. Plus we've fixed that pesky bug causing you to lose rank points when you were clearly the best player. 🕷️

❄️ [b]Frost Beam[/b] ❄️
Ever wanted to freeze your opponents? Well now you can, with this new pick up! Shoot a Frost Beam in front of you causing opponents to skid across the tracks and lose control! 🧊

🚀 [b]Air Strike[/b] 🚀
Prepare for mayhem with our new Air Strike pick up! Fire an aerial strike at an opponent, homing in on them, creating an explosion area of effect as it hits the ground! 💥

🪝 [b]Grapple Hook[/b] 🪝
There's a new core! Grapple Hook latches your car onto your ball, slowing your ball as your car propels towards it! 🪢

🦈 [b]Shark Event[/b] 🦈
We've got some new missions for you to sink your teeth into... The Shark Event (Part 1) is now live! You have a few weeks to collect the first half of this jawesome set of items! 🌊

🏪 [b]Shop and Garage Updates[/b] 🏪
You can now purchase random chests in the shop, featuring past rewards from seasons 1 and 2! The garage also displays how many items you have left to collect! Most importantly, car bodies are back in the shop and available to purchase! 🪙

⛳ [b]New Levels[/b] ⛳
There are 4 new space levels to try out! But better than that, the community design, Big L, has been added! Be sure to [url=https://discord.com/invite/TurboGR]join our discord[/url] and enter our community competitions to have your designs added to the game! 🖌️

notes.title: An Introduction to Power Cores Part 1
notes.notes:
What’s up racers?

We can’t believe that [i]Turbo Golf Racing[/i] is literally less than a week away from launching! The excitement here at Hugecalf is at maximum overdrive and we can’t wait to join you in-game on August 4th.

Ahead of next week’s launch, we wanted to give you a brief overview of the game’s Power Core system. It’s a key component to getting a competitive edge on your opponents on the fairway, as this allows you to customise your vehicle to suit your playstyle.

[h3][b]Types of Power Core:[/b][/h3]
There are two types of Power Core: Passive and Active. As the name suggests, Passive Cores are ‘always on’ and you don’t need to worry about activating them mid-race. Active Cores on the other hand need to be triggered during a race with a simple button press, and have a short cooldown before they can be used again. 

[h3][b]Power Core Sockets:[/b][/h3]
Each vehicle is equipped with two Power Core Sockets that give players the freedom to mix-and-match Power Cores to suit their playstyle. The Power Socket permits the use of either Passive or Active Power Cores, while the Passive Socket will only accept Passive Power Cores. 

[h3][b]Unlocking Power Cores:[/b][/h3]
Power Cores are unlocked by completing various challenges in-game. For example, to unlock the Hot Head Power Core, you must complete five online matches.

[h3][b]Active Power Cores:[/b][/h3]
Today, we’re going to cover just the three Active Power Cores and we’ll have a separate post tomorrow looking at the Passive Power Cores.

[h2]Active Cores[/h2]

    [tr]
        [td][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42160825/125dfa82812d1519099b853a383467126a7dd256.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42160825/f9c3d8a953887ce086601fa44f022ef1d51baace.png[/img][/url][/td]

notes.title: What's the deal with all the wacky golf games?
notes.notes:
Would you believe Good Friday isn't a bank holiday in Ireland? I didn't, until I found myself living it. I'm here driving the RPS bus alone, nobody to stop me as I careen down the motorway screaming and trying to slam on the brakes. But I can't, because a golf ball has rolled under the pedal!

You ride this bus long enough, you see games move in cycles similar to fashion designers, or those big ferris wheels at fairgrounds. Things come round, they peak, they go round again. Often a few different people independently notice an empty niche and start working on something to fill it, so you get a bunch of games with similar themes or styles coming out within months of each other. So I ask: why and/or how have a bunch of people identified golf as a gap in the market?
